title: Shift compatibility of the specified refinement-restriction transformation
statement:
∀ (θ : ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ push R r.hom) ⋙ pull R d.i ⟶
        (openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i),
      (∀ M, θ.app M = refinementRestriction R r hi M) → θ.CommShift ℤ

proof.text: Apply `NatTrans.CommShift.of_core` to the arbitrary transformation. Evaluating the shift square at an object and rewriting both components with hθ reduces it to the pointwise shift equation for the explicitly defined refinementRestriction map.

lean.statement: theorem refinementRestriction_data_shift (θ : ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ push R r.hom) ⋙ pull R d.i ⟶ (openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i) (hθ : ∀ M, θ.app M = refinementRestriction R r hi M) : θ.CommShift ℤ
